title: Data and code for: Size of a hydrogen plasma controls methane conversion in its afterglow
description:
Measurement data (0D and 2D Raman gas temperature and H2 dissociation measurements, gas chromatography results), plasma chemistry model results and the code to reproduce all figures of: M.D. Ruijzendaal, M.L. Azevedo, J. Vargas, M. Arboleda Rodallega, T.D. Butterworth, G.J. van Rooij, P. Diomede and N. den Harder, "Size of a hydrogen plasma controls methane conversion in its afterglow" (in preparation).

Code: MIT license. Data: CC BY 4.0.
